en-US.description: Ask ABUZ8 is the voice concierge for an autonomous agent company. Agents claim work is done; this skill never takes their word for it. Every mission lives in an append-only ISNAD ledger -- a claim is not a fact, and only a separate verification event moves a mission to VERIFIED. Ask for your company status, drill into what is still only claimed, and decide Tier-3 actions (anything that sends, spends, or publishes) by voice. Decisions are hash-bound: your spoken yes applies only to the exact payload you were presented, identified by its SHA-256. If the payload changed after the request, the decision is refused and the request is voided -- in code, not in a prompt. The skill is a front-end to a self-hosted MCP server (spec 2025-11-25, Streamable HTTP) and works unchanged against the owner's live company feed.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask ABUZ8 for my company status
Alexa, ask ABUZ8 what is still only claimed
Alexa, ask ABUZ8 if there are any approvals waiting
en-US.name: Ask ABUZ8
en-US.summary: Verified status and hash-bound approvals for your agent company, by voice. Claimed is not done.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: REPLACE_ME before submission. Smoke path once the endpoint is live: (1) 'Alexa, open ask a b u z 8' then 'company status' -- expect the ISNAD roll-up, never a claim reported as fact. (2) 'what is still only claimed' -- expect the CLAIMED missions, labeled unverified. (3) 'approvals waiting' then 'approve it' -- expect the decision recorded against the presented payload hash. (4) Re-present the same action with an edited payload to confirm the decision is refused and the request voided.
